chapter: Other drummers and New Orleans musicians
title: Cymbal on the bass drum
summary: The cymbal was mounted on the bass drum and sometimes struck with a coat-hanger rim.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Oh, that's something I wanted to ask you while we're on that subject, of street drums. When you started out, who played the cymbal, the snare drum or the bass drum? Oh, the bass drum.
The cymbal was always on the bass drum.
I see. And how big a cymbal was it?
Well, just about the same sound we were using now.
Same thing now, that didn't change? No, it hasn't changed.
And what did he hit it with? Well a lot of times we made a, just taking a coat hanger off, a piece of white and made a rim.
